item.title: Trump lashes out at 'sick' Iranian leaders, confirms estimated timeline for ending war
item.summary: NATO failed a test by not joining the U.S. military operation against Iran, President Donald Trump said during a Thursday Cabinet meeting.

item.title: America’s ‘undeclared emergency:’ Palantir exec talks Iran, deadly new US weapons and how to avoid World War 3
item.summary: Palantir CTO Shyam Sankar warns the U.S. faces an 'undeclared emergency' and urges sweeping investment to deter World War III in his new book.

item.title: Blagojevich warns justice system is 'broken,' says his case was blueprint for Trump prosecutions
item.summary: Former Illinois Gov. Rod Blagojevich claims his corruption prosecution paved the way for Trump's legal battles, calling the justice system broken.

item.title: Melvin Foster, former college football star who later served as Texas deputy sheriff, dead at 59
item.summary: Melvin Foster, a former star with the Iowa Hawkeyes who later served as a Texas sheriff's deputy, has died at the age of 59. His death was described as "unexpected."

item.title: Reporter's Notebook: GOP's 'favorite bill' faces reality check as Senate stalls on SAVE America Act
item.summary: Senate Republicans are using the SAVE America Act as a messaging tool, but the voter ID bill lacks the votes to pass and faces a likely punt.

item.title: Yankees shortstop José Caballero makes MLB history, becomes first player to use Automated Ball-Strike System
item.summary: New York Yankees shortstop José Caballero made MLB history as the first player to use the Automated Ball-Strike System, losing his challenge on opening day.

item.title: Carrie Underwood shares secret to raising grounded children on Tennessee farm
item.summary: Carrie Underwood says she stays grounded at her Tennessee farm, making dinner and getting covered in dirt — and hopes that's what her sons remember most.

item.title: Illinois Democrat condemns party members rallying with far-left streamer Hasan Piker
item.summary: Illinois Democratic Rep. Brad Schneider criticized Democratic members and candidates for associating with Hasan Piker, whom he labeled an unapologetic antisemite.

item.title: Harvard student says Jewish classmates feel 'unwelcome' as multibillion dollar DOJ lawsuit looms
item.summary: A Harvard sophomore says Jewish students feel unwelcome as the Trump DOJ files a multibillion-dollar lawsuit over the school's handling of antisemitism.

item.title: Hotel fees are draining Americans' wallets as expert reveals how to avoid paying hundreds extra
item.summary: Resort fees are not going away, a NerdWallet study finds, despite a new FTC rule that now requires hotels to show full prices upfront. An expert shared tips as travelers react.
